title: Detailed teddy bear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Left ear -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='24' r='12' fill='#C97A3D'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='24' r='7' fill='#E8A86B'/>
  <!-- Right ear -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='24' r='12' fill='#C97A3D'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='24' r='7' fill='#E8A86B'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='26' ry='23' fill='#D4883F'/>
  <!-- Forehead highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='28' rx='14' ry='7' fill='#E8A86B' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='15' ry='11' fill='#F0C890'/>
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='34' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#5B2E10'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='32.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='34' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#5B2E10'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='32.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#3A1A08'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='3' ry='1.5' fill='#5B2E10' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M50 44.5 Q46 49 43 47' stroke='#3A1A08' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 44.5 Q54 49 57 47' stroke='#3A1A08' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='25' ry='23' fill='#D4883F'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='15' ry='14' fill='#F0C890'/>
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='66' rx='9' ry='14' fill='#C97A3D' transform='rotate(20 22 66)'/>
  <ellipse cx='21' cy='78' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#E8A86B' transform='rotate(20 21 78)'/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='66' rx='9' ry='14' fill='#C97A3D' transform='rotate(-20 78 66)'/>
  <ellipse cx='79' cy='78' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#E8A86B' transform='rotate(-20 79 78)'/>
  <!-- Left leg -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='92' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#C97A3D'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='94' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#E8A86B'/>
  <!-- Right leg -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='92' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#C97A3D'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='94' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#E8A86B'/>
  <!-- Bow tie -->
  <polygon points='50,52 40,47 40,57' fill='#E84B6F'/>
  <polygon points='50,52 60,47 60,57' fill='#E84B6F'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='3' fill='#C4284E'/>
  <!-- Stitch details on ears -->
  <path d='M23 18 Q28 21 33 18' stroke='#A05A28' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M67 18 Q72 21 77 18' stroke='#A05A28' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Patch on belly -->
  <rect x='44' y='68' width='10' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#E8A86B'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='72.5' x2='54' y2='72.5' stroke='#D4883F' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-dasharray='1.5 1.5'/>
  <line x1='49' y1='68' x2='49' y2='77' stroke='#D4883F' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-dasharray='1.5 1.5'/>
</svg>
